name: Abandoned or Vacant City Owned Property Concerns
description: Report concerns about an abandoned or vacant city-owned property, which should be unoccupied. Attaching a photo is helpful.

name: Abandoned or Vacant Private Property Concerns
description: Report concerns about an abandoned or vacant private property. Attaching a photo is helpful.

name: Abandoned Vehicle to Report
description: Report an abandoned vehicle (car) without license plates or that is inoperable. Please provide details such as color, make, and location. A photo of the vehicle and plate is helpful.

name: Accessibility Concerns on City Property
description: Report accessibility concerns on city/public property. Include a description and location. A photo is helpful.

name: Accessibility Concerns on Private Property
description: Report accessibility concerns on private property. Include a description and location. A photo is helpful.

name: Accessible and Handicapped Parking Sign Requests
description: If you are requesting an accessible/handicap parking sign, submit the request with the address of where the sign is to be placed, upload the vehicle registration and the disability parking certificate issued by the Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV). DO NOT UPLOAD THE PLACCARD IN PLACE OF THE CERTIFICATE. If the address on the registration and certificate do not match, include a statement explaining why.

name: Accessible Parking Issues or Concerns
description: Report accessibility issues at existing parking spaces. Parking in handicapped spaces without a placard should be called into the police in the moment at 401-272-3121. Please include a description of the problem.

name: After-School Program Information
description: Request information about after-school programs from the Recreation Department.

name: Animal Control Concerns
description: Report loose or barking dogs to Animal Control at (401) 272-1111. Report a lost pet or request information.

name: Assistance or Concern with a Business License
description: Request assistance with a business license. Please specify what type of license you are seeking.

name: Assistance or Concern with a City Cemetery
description: Report issues or repairs needed at city owned cemeteries.

name: Bike Path and Lane Issues or Concerns
description: Report bike lane and bike path maintenance concerns. Also, if you have any questions about bike lanes in Providence.

name: Blocked Storm Drain or Catch Basin
description: Report street drains blocked by debris of any kind.

name: Broken Water Pipe or Water Leaks
description: Please report broken or leaky water pipes and valves in city streets. For emergencies, please call Providence Water directly: 401-521-6300

name: Building Code Violations
description: Report building code violations and provide details and location.

name: Business License Assistance
description: Request help with a business license. Specify the type of license.

name: City Claim Questions
description: Need to file a claim due to damages or have a question? Follow this link for details : https://council.providenceri.gov/clerk-claims/

name: City Sponsored Event Information
description: Requesting city-sponsored event information. Please list the events you would like to receive information about.

name: City-Owned Property Concerns
description: Report vandalism, broken windows, or other issues with city-owned property. A photo is helpful

name: Concern about a Wheelchair Ramp on Private Property
description: Report concerns about a wheelchair ramp on private property. Provide a description and location.

name: Concerns about a Business
description: Report licensing or operational concerns (e.g., outdoor seating, valet parking, alcohol licenses). Noise complaints should be reported to police at (401) 272-3121.

name: Concerns or Issues on the Pedestrian Bridge
description: Report any concerns or issues at the Pedestrian Bridge.

name: Concerns with a Construction Site
description: Report an unsecured, unsafe, or improperly contained construction site. Please provide details and location.

name: Contact City Council
description: Submit concerns, requests or questions for City Council.

name: Crosswalk and Road Striping Concerns
description: Report faded or missing road or crosswalk markings. Include location and intersection.

name: Damaged Manhole or Utility Cover
description: Report a damaged manhole or utility cover. Provide location or intersection.

name: Damaged Storm Drain or Catch Basin
description: Report damaged street drain grates or structures.

name: Dead Animal on Roadway or Sidewalk
description: Report a dead animal in the public right-of-way. Specify the type of animal if possible.

name: Decorative Street Light Issue
description: Report problems with decorative streetlights (lights with baskets around the bulb). Provide the location.

name: Defective or Failed Utility Trench Repairs
description: Report defective or failed utility trench patch. These are squared cutouts left from utility work. Providing the exact location and a photo is helpful.

name: Disaster Preparedness Information
description: Need disaster preparedness information? Make sure to provide your contact information.

name: Discarded Syringes
description: Report discarded syringes. Include as much details on location. Photos are helpful.

name: Downed Wire or Leaning Utility Pole
description: Report any down wire or leaning utility pole directly to Rhode Island Energy at (855) 743-1101 and say "downed power line"

name: Elections and Voting Information
description: Request information about elections and voting from the Board of Canvassers.

name: Electric Scooter Issues
description: Report issues with rentable devices in the city. If possible, please provide a photo and a clear description of its location.

name: Electrical, Mechanical, Plumbing Inspection Requests
description: Request the inspection needed or visit https://providenceri.portal.opengov.com/categories/1072 for additional information

name: Emergency and Disaster Information
description: Please submit your request here. Also, visit PEMA's webpage for more information at - https://www.providenceri.gov/pema/plan-emergencies-disasters/

name: Encampment Concern(s)
description: Report encampments or tents here. Be as specific on the location. The city works with service providers and state agencies to assist the unhoused population.

name: Energy Efficiency Issues
description: Request information related to any energy efficiency issues or concerns.

name: Faulty Plumbing or Raw Sewage
description: Please provide all information related to faulty plumbing or raw sewage, address needed.

name: Fire Hydrant Issue
description: Report leaky, sinking, or damaged fire hydrants.

name: Food Assistance Information
description: Request food assistance information.

name: General Question or Concern DPW related
description: Use this request type for overall questions or concerns related to the Department of Public Works (ie - questions about a permit or process etc.)

name: General Questions, Comments or Concerns
description: Submit general questions, comments or concerns about city services or a city department.

name: Graffiti in a Park
description: Report graffiti in city park property. Adding a photograph is very helpful.

name: Graffiti on City-Owned Property
description: Report graffiti on city-owned property. Make sure to include where on the surface is the graffiti (ie. on the window of the property). Adding as much details in the description and a photograph is very helpful.

name: Graffiti on Private Property
description: Property owners are responsible for removing graffiti on their property. Property owners are encouraged to file a police report if graffiti is considered vandalism.

name: Hate Crime
description: Report incidents of hate crimes. You can also email the Human Relations Commission at hrc@providenceri.gov.

name: Hazardous Waste Disposal
description: Report hazardous waste materials. Provide as much details and location.

name: Home Repair Assistance
description: Request home repair assistance or information. Provide contact details.

name: Housing Assistance Information
description: Request information about housing assistance. Provide contact information.

name: I do not know know how to classify my issue or service request.
description: Submit your concerns if you do not know which case type to select. Please provide the most accurate description possible. PVD311 will report your concerns to the appropriate department.

name: Illegal Business or Vending Operations
description: Report an unlicensed business or vending concern. Provide as much details as possible.

name: Illegal Dumping
description: Report illegal dumping in the city. Provide the location and details of the dumped items. A photo is helpful.

name: Illegal Housing Issues or Concerns
description: Report an illegal dwelling, such as in a basement or an attic. Please note, that the city will need to be provided access to the dwelling unit to assess for violations.

name: Information about events in the City
description: Request information about events in Providence.

name: Information on Public Art
description: Request information about public art in the city.

name: Job Training Information
description: Request information about job training opportunities.

name: Maintenance Issue in a City Park
description: Report damage, trash or other maintenance needs in a city park

name: Maintenance Issue on City Property
description: Report damage, trash, or other maintenance needs in public, city-owned facilities.

name: Missed Trash Day Pick-up Issue
description: Please report missed pickups on your trash day. Indicate whether it is trash, recycling, yard waste or a bulky item (if applicable. Provide the WM confirmation number if you have one and the number of bags for yard waste.

name: Missing Manhole or Utility Cover
description: Report Missing Manhole or Utility Cover - provide as much details, including location.

name: No Public Utilities
description: Report no electricity, water, or heat.

name: Noise or Sound Disturbances
description: Call the non-emergency line at (401) 272-3121 to report disturbances happening in real-time and to police to respond accordingly. Report to PVD311 for documentation purposes.

name: Overflowing Dumpster
description: Report any overflowing dumpsters. Provide exact location. Photos are helpful.

name: Overgrowth or High Grass on Private Property
description: Report vegetation overgrowth on a private property, especially if blocking sidewalks.

name: Overgrowth or High Grass Public Property
description: Report overgrowth at parks, memorials, traffic islands or other public spaces.

name: Overnight Parking Violations
description: Report vehicles parked in restricted areas overnight. Only permitted vehicles may park on the street overnight.

name: Parking Issues to Report
description: Report a concern or a parking issue such as illegal parking. Provide location and vehicle details. You should also call the non-emergency police number for real time reporting 401.272.3121.

name: Parking Meters Malfunction
description: Report issues with a single or multi-space parking meter.

name: Permit Issues at a Construction Site
description: Report concerns about incorrect or missing permits at a construction site.

name: Plastic Bag Ban Violation
description: Report single-use plastic bags or other prohibited checkout bag provided by a business in Providence. Providence’s Retail Plastic Bag Ban prohibits businesses from offering single-use plastic bags and paper bags made from non-recycled paper. If you see a business in violation, please report it so we can enforce the law. Providence’s Retail Plastic Bag Ban went into effect on 10/22/19.There is also a statewide ban on the use of plastic bags.

name: Pothole Report
description: Report potholes for patching. Note that winter operations may impact the resolution time of this request.

name: PPSD - Transportation Inquiry
description: Submit a question, concern, or service request about Providence Public School District (PPSD) student transportation, including school buses, bus stops, routes, schedules, delays, or other transportation issues. Contact information 401-456-9269, text 401-420-7960, and transportation@ppsd.org

name: PPSD Registration Inquiry
description: Submit a question or request for assistance with Providence Public School District student registration, enrollment, school placement, transfers, required documents, or the registration process. Contact information - Phone: 401-456-9297 | Email: inforeg@ppsd.org | Text: 401-420-7189 | Registration Center: 325 Ocean Street, Providence | Hours: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM-4:00 PM

name: Providence Fire Department Inquiry
description: Submit a request or concern to the Providence Fire Department.

name: Providence Police Department Inquiry
description: Submit a request or concern to the Providence Police Department.

name: Providence Water Engineering Issues
description: Report issues or concerns with water engineering matters.

name: Public Transit Issues and Concerns
description: Report any concerns with RIPTA or issues around the bus shelters. Please provide location.

name: Recreational Programs
description: Request information about the city's recreational programs.

name: Register to Film in the City
description: Request information on how to apply to film in the city.

name: Repair a Parking Sign
description: Report downed, faded, or damaged parking signs to be repaired or replaced.

name: Repair a Traffic Sign
description: Report downed, faded, or damaged traffic signs to be repaired or replaced.

name: Repair Existing Guardrail
description: Request Repair to Existing Guardrail - provide as much details, including location.

name: Report a City Employee Misconduct
description: Submit concerns about city employee misconduct.

name: Report a Leaning City Streetlight Pole
description: Report a down city pole or a streetlight pole.

name: Report a Smell of Gas
description: Provide details or report directly to Rhode Island Energy at (855) 743-1102 for faster service. You can also report it online at https://selfserve.rienergy.com/report-an-outage/report-issue

name: Report an issue with Passport Parking App
description: Report issues with the Passport Parking App. Be specific on the problems encountered.

name: Report Discrimination
description: Report discrimination in employment, housing, credit, public accommodations, or services.

name: Report General Public Safety Issues or Concerns
description: Report any issues or concern related to public safety. All urgent matters should be reported immediately to the police in real time at 401-272-3121.

name: Report Public Health Hazards
description: hazardous materials. Provide details and location.

name: Report Sewage Backup
description: Report sewage backup concerns. Contact information is helpful. For emergencies or after hour please call (401) 919-0262.

name: Report Street Flooding
description: Report street flooding with location, intersection and any details. For emergencies or after hour please call (401) 919-0262.

name: Report Street Light Issue
description: City street lights are easily identified by their curved neck. Street lights are often on telephone poles or freestanding aluminum poles, so please provide the pole number and location.

name: Report Suspicious Activity
description: Report any suspicious activity to the Police Department as it is happening. You can use this system for data reporting.

name: Report Un-shoveled Sidewalks
description: Report any sidewalks not cleared of snow. Provide location. City ordinance states that property owners must clear their sidewalks of snow within 8 hours after the snow event ends.

name: Report Voter Intimidation Activity
description: Report information related to voter intimidation activities at polling places.

name: Request a New Parking Sign
description: Request a new parking sign. Specify the location and type of sign.

name: Request a New Traffic Sign
description: Request a new traffic sign. Specify the location and type of sign.

name: Request Reboarding of Abandoned Property
description: Report an abandoned property that needs to be reboarded to avoid safety hazards.

name: Request Rodent Baiting Information
description: Owner-occupied properties can request rodent baiting on our website: https://www.providenceri.gov/public-works/forms/

name: Request Street Repair(s)
description: Report roads in need of significant patching. We'll evaluate for any quick fixes and refer it to our repairs database for permanent repairs. Please note that requests to repair entire roads may take a considerable amount of time to complete.

name: Reserve Private Events in City Hall
description: Request hosting a private event in City Hall or call Public Property at (401) 680-5508 to schedule an appointment to see the rental spaces in City Hall.

name: Senior Services
description: Request information about senior centers, transportation, or other services.

name: Sidewalk Issue that is Tree-Related
description: Request to repair a sidewalk that has become damaged by a city tree. Please note that for the health of the tree, repairs to sidewalks are carefully coordinated, and may affect resolution time.

name: Sidewalk Panel Repair
description: Request the repair of a sidewalk panel. Provide all details and photos.

name: Sidewalk Panel Request
description: Request the installation of a sidewalk panel where one does not currently exist to complete the sidewalk. Provide all details and photos.

name: Sinkhole Concern
description: Sinkholes are holes in the ground which are caused by an empty space beneath. They often begin as depressions and often do not have visible bottoms. Repairs require repairing the substructure. Provide location or intersection.

name: Small Business Support
description: Request information about small businesses in Providence. Please provide contact information and details of the requested information.

name: Snow Plowing or Salting or Sanding Request
description: Report any city street or road the needs to be treated due to winter conditions.

name: Speeding and Traffic Calming Concerns
description: Report speeding observed or traffic calming concerns. Urgent matters should be reported to the police at (401) 272-3121.

name: Street Closure Request
description: Report or request information on temporary sidewalk/street occupation or closure

name: Street Sweeping Issue or Concern
description: The majority of street sweeping requests will be handled as part of the city's street sweeping program. If there are areas in need of special attention, report them here.

name: Substandard Housing Code Issues or Violations
description: Use this service request to report any housing code violations such as vermin infestations or structural issues. Please note we will need to be provided access to consider these violations.

name: Tax Assessor Inquiry
description: Request assistance or ask a question related to your tax bill. The Assessor’s Office is also the keeper of records of all real estate, tangible and motor vehicle tax records.

name: Tax Collector Inquiry
description: Request assistance or ask a question related to your paying your tax bill. The Tax Collector's Office sends out annual bills in June and processes quarterly payments for Real Estate, Personal Property/Tangible, and Motor Vehicle taxes.

name: Traffic Control Issues or Changes
description: Report any traffic flow or safety concern other than speeding which is addressed in the Traffic calming request type. this would include traffic congestion, safety improvements, one way street changes and all way stop conditions at intersections.

name: Traffic Signal Malfunction
description: Reports a malfunctioning traffic signal or crossing signal. Provide intersection.

name: Trash on Private Property or Sidewalk
description: Please note that private properties and their abutting sidewalks are maintained by that private property/business owner. Please include address and details.

name: Trash on Streets and Public Property
description: Report any trash or debris in the street (sidewalks excluded) or on a public property.

name: Trash or Recycling Bins or Cans Left Out
description: Report trash or recycling bins or cans eft out on the curb or sidewalk after trash day. We'll let the owner know to bring them back onto their property.

name: Trash or Recycling Bins or Carts
description: Report if you have not received a new trash or recycling bin.

name: Tree Related Issue(s)
description: Report any request for tree pruning or other concerns related to a city owned tree. Photographs are helpful.

name: Urban Planning & Green Spaces
description: Request information on urban planning and infrastructure. Make sure to include the details of the inforamtion requested.

name: Vital Records Inquiry
description: Request certified birth, marriage, and death certificates, marriage licenses and file records for deaths that take place in Providence.

name: Water Meter Issue
description: Report issues or concerns with your water meter.

name: Water Quality Issues or Concerns
description: Report any water quality issue such as a change in color, taste or smell.

name: Zoning Violation Concerns
description: Reporting any zoning related concerns such as over paving, too many chickens, commercial use in a residential district/residential structure, parking on lawns/not using curb cuts to access parking, commercial vehicles (big box trucks, or heavy machinery type vehicles) parked on going on residential lots or short Term Rental in a residential zone where not owner-occupied
